subject.title: fix(media): bound hung remote downloads in media store

question: Should generic gateway and QA media-store downloads use unconditional 30-second header and idle deadlines, or should the header deadline be longer or internally caller-selectable?
rationale: The lifecycle repair is technically sound, but current integrations intentionally use different media timeout values, so repository evidence does not establish one universal generic header deadline.

options.title: Use 30 seconds for both
options.body: Accept the PR's uniform safety bound for all generic media-store callers.

options.title: Use a longer header deadline
options.body: Keep a 30-second idle bound but align initial header waiting with slower integrations such as Telegram's 120-second policy.

options.title: Allow an internal override
options.body: Keep safe defaults while permitting only known internal callers to request a longer deadline.

recommendation.title: Use 30 seconds for both
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's uniform safety bound for all generic media-store callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The original media source path and the largest share of sustained history across the central media files trace to @steipete.
